Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
args.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. The handleClick function's call to exportReport only has a .then() handler, so when the returned promise rejects (e.g. the server responds with a non-2xx status and exportReport throws), setBusy(false) is never called and the button stays disabled until the page is reloaded. Add a .catch() (or try/catch) that resets busy to false and shows an error toast on failure, so the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.
